verdict.rationale: Windmill's documented webhooks are inbound trigger endpoints that start scripts and flows. The pack contains no evidence of registrable outbound HTTP callbacks that notify an external consumer when events occur. Inbound triggering is the opposite direction, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit for subscribing to events.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Use schedules, webhooks, emails, HTTP routes, websockets, Kafka, Postgres, NATS, SQS, MQTT, GCP, Azure Event Grid and more.
Flows additionally expose version-pinned webhook endpoints that target a specific flow version by its numeric version ID instead of the latest deployment.
